scope: Independent correctness review of the two runtime owners and related offline tests; uncommitted source bytes, not final documentation, CI, deployment or real Telegram acceptance.
checks: Only eligible verbatim public topic/language reaches the existing fixed public endpoints; personal/reply/media/unknown-queue eligibility and source fences remain unchanged.

Search generator has at most three candidates and fifty inbound aliases; no pagination or broad query generation; at most search plus summary HTTP, six-second cancellable network bound and 64 KiB per response remain.

All returned candidate and alias objects are validated before selection, including non-bool positive IDs, namespace, title, fragments, duplicate alias/candidate IDs, ID intersections and normalized name ownership across different target page IDs.

Canonical exact match may tolerate valid incomplete unrelated alias properties only after known conflicts are rejected. Alias-only matching requires batchcomplete strictly true and no rdcontinue; this is bounded matching, not proof of site-wide uniqueness.
Summary type, strict page ID, title and extract gates remain. Missing or unusable source gives honest uncertainty; no unsupported model retry or product-specific identity exception.

Only getChatMember/getMe have at most two HTTP attempts. Read payload is deep-copied before asynchronous mutation; total twenty-second timeout covers attempts and delay, each read attempt has eight seconds, retry delay is 0.25 seconds.

Folded TransportError/TimeoutError and HTTP 500/502/503/504 are bounded recovery candidates. Recognizable UnsupportedProtocol/LocalProtocolError, 429, permanent HTTP status, malformed result and identity mismatch do not receive a local retry.

CancelledError propagates; network DNS/headers/body cancellation leaves no second send. sendMessage remains one attempt, with existing unknown-send and lease/request/CONTROL/source/budget fences unchanged.

HTTPX INFO and HTTPCore DEBUG logs were captured through the actual shared transport with synthetic credentials: no credential in records or exception chains; context-local suppression is restored for unrelated callers. Fixed outcome/operation/attempt/elapsed fields contain no request, source, response or model text.
Shared transport mapping, dependencies, layer, provider/model, runtime configuration, delivery owners and other runtime files are unchanged.

independent_controls.transport: Actual zerde_common async HTTP adapter and HTTPCore with synthetic resolver/network streams; all real socket connections/DNS blocked.

earlier_run.scope: Before the three alias-structure tests and one immutable-read-payload test were added.

validation.fixture_correction: The first independent harness incorrectly applied a 25ms deadline to successful real-adapter TLS/client setup and failed its expected-success assertion. The harness was corrected to use normal 8s/20s success deadlines and shortened deadlines only for deliberate cancellation; all nineteen controls then passed on final source. This was not counted as an implementation failure or hidden as a first-pass success.

limits: The main full-suite run, hosted CI and packaging/deployment are not independently asserted by this report. Source commit binding requires a later fresh commit readback.
No AWS, Telegram UI, model, real public API, old raw, runtime raw or frozen formal entry was called/read by this review.

The prior single-page diagnostic cannot prove the cause or ownership of B timeout; underlying cause remains UNKNOWN. B usefulness and new A/B/P acceptance remain pending a separately authorized fresh window.
Lexical public-topic restrictions and bounded matching do not prove all names public or all generated facts true. Successful recovery does not prove every TransportError transient.
Documentation changes are outside this source review. Original fifteen retention duties and frozen evidence are not altered.
